# BOLERO_PATH: Set up
env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# BOLERO_PATH: Fetch with insecure, should error
! bolero get -insecure test
stderr 'bolero: -insecure flag is no longer supported; use BOLERO_INSECURE instead'

# Modules: Set up
env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# Modules: Fetch with insecure, should error
! bolero get -insecure test
stderr 'bolero: -insecure flag is no longer supported; use BOLERO_INSECURE instead'
